notes: whether ... or is one correlative rendering of the single waw under rule 14, headed on the closing or; the two be prepositions are not what whether says, so they go unrepresented under rule 40, exactly as rule 14's la-zakhar 'o la-neqebah example directs.

The supplied he of whether he be home born is added: no nominal or pronominal morpheme stands in the clause, and rule 41's supplied pronoun is reserved for an article on a participle or adjective, which 'ezrach is not.
nebelah and terefah are nouns the ASV recasts as relative clauses, which rule 46's closing rider keeps whole with the noun, headed on the lexeme-bearing dieth and torn.
home born is headed on home by rule 31's subtraction test, but the tie with born is genuine.
